source.name: Wanted Design System Community
source.purpose: State whether LDS can truthfully claim complete WDS coverage parity.

claimPolicy: Full WDS coverage can only be claimed when every local evidence map is valid and every Figma node-level queue item is closed or explicitly accepted as a theme override.

localEvidenceGates.criteria: All known WDS top-level Theme, Element, and Component sections are represented with LDS coverage references.
WDS theme and element foundations are mapped to LDS tokens, stories, files, or LK theme overrides.
Local PDF exports from Figma are preserved and mapped to LDS token/story evidence for Basic, Spacing, and Decorate foundations.
Local PDF exports from Figma are preserved and mapped to LDS component/story evidence for Layout and Action sections.
Every TOKEN_MAP component family has implementation and Storybook evidence.
Every public LDS export is classified as WDS core, theme override, product extension, or robotics extension.

The checked-in WDS .fig export is decoded into source node summaries for Foundation, Theme, Element, Component, Resource, Guidelines, and Updates with text, section labels, variant-like symbol names, dimensions, visual samples, and page section indexes.
Variant, state, slot, and behavior checks exist with Storybook evidence, but WDS source parity is still pending.
Every coverage row has a concrete Figma source node, local evidence, closure criteria, and next Figma reads.

completionCriteria: Every Figma node audit queue row is `confirmed-covered` or has an explicitly approved theme override review.
Every required external Figma read has been performed and recorded in the corresponding audit row.
Storybook static build and WDS alignment scripts pass after the final Figma parity update.

notReadyReasons.detail: Figma MCP Starter plan rate limit prevents live reads for the current Figma URL. Local .fig content extraction is available, but live source parity remains unconfirmed.
Node-level local .fig content is extracted, but queue rows remain pending until live Figma reads are performed or the checked-in export is accepted as the authoritative source snapshot.
